description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for handling 'sale shipping' reports in an OpenCart admin extension. The class manages displaying the report, saving report settings, and generating report data, including filtering, pagination, and view rendering.

classes.name: SaleShipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sale shipping report in the OpenCart admin panel, including displaying, saving settings, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads necessary language files, sets page titles, breadcrumbs, and loads the report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings, verifies permissions, and responds with success or error in JSON format.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the report view, including report data and filters, for the 'sale shipping' report.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list data, primarily by invoking getReport.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates the report data based on provided filters, handles pagination, and returns the view with report results.
